title: Project 3 · Catch a broken edit
prompt: A correct rename returns a new task with the new title and the same ID, and leaves the original task unchanged. Write catchesBrokenRename(rename): boolean. Call the supplied rename on a task you create. Return true when it behaves correctly and false when it changes the original task or loses the ID.
hints: Create a task and keep a reference to it.
Check the returned title and ID.
After the call, check that the original title did not change.
checks: catchesBrokenRename((task, title) => { task.title = title; return task; }) === false
catchesBrokenRename((task, title) => ({ id: "", title, status: task.status })) === false
(() => { let calls = 0; catchesBrokenRename((task, title) => { calls++; return { ...task, title }; }); return calls > 0; })()

wrongAnswers.misconception: Checks only the new title, so a mutating rename passes.

feedback: A good regression check fails on each broken behavior. Check the returned task and the original.
